_source: Chinese fields were first parsed from docs/宝藏效果总表.md; that parser is not in the repo, so this file is now maintained by hand — keep it and the doc in sync. The *_en fields are hand-written. The sets section is the only copy of the set bonus text: the codex and the prep treasure detail both read it.

def_life_monument.name: 生命丰碑
def_life_monument.effect: 我方普通棋子最大生命 +20%，当前生命同步提高；胡牌手激活后为 +40%
def_life_monument.effect_en: Allied normal pieces gain +20% max HP, current HP raised to match; +40% once Winning Hand is active

def_formation_heal.name: 法阵回春
def_formation_heal.effect: 胜利或平局后法阵 HP +1，失败后 +2，不超过初始上限
def_formation_heal.effect_en: After a win or draw, restore 1 formation HP; after a loss, restore 2, up to the starting cap

def_soul_counter.name: 亡魂反击
def_soul_counter.effect: 我方普通棋子死亡时，对击杀者造成击杀者最大生命 35% 真实伤害
def_soul_counter.effect_en: When an allied normal piece dies, deal 35% of the killer's max HP to the killer as true damage
def_soul_counter.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece dies

def_lifesteal_emblem.name: 吸血纹章
def_lifesteal_emblem.effect: 我方普通棋子造成伤害后，回复实际伤害 20% 的生命
def_lifesteal_emblem.effect_en: Allied normal pieces heal for 20% of the damage they actually deal
def_lifesteal_emblem.trigger_en: After a normal piece deals damage

ctrl_shockwave.name: 震荡余波
ctrl_shockwave.effect: 当前目标眩晕 1 秒，冷却 5 秒；胡牌手激活后眩晕 2 秒
ctrl_shockwave.effect_en: Stun the current target for 1s, 5s cooldown; 2s once Winning Hand is active
ctrl_shockwave.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

ctrl_corrosive_needle.name: 腐蚀毒针
ctrl_corrosive_needle.effect: 每第 4 次攻击使目标失血 3 秒，冷却 5 秒
ctrl_corrosive_needle.effect_en: Every 4th attack bleeds the target for 3s, 5s cooldown
ctrl_corrosive_needle.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

ctrl_interrupt_chain.name: 打断锁链
ctrl_interrupt_chain.effect: 攻击时 25% 概率缴械目标 1.5 秒，冷却 3 秒
ctrl_interrupt_chain.effect_en: On attack, 25% chance to disarm for 1.5s, 3s cooldown
ctrl_interrupt_chain.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

ctrl_time_compress.name: 时空压缩
ctrl_time_compress.effect: 我方普通棋子技能冷却缩短 25%，首次与后续冷却均乘以 0.75
ctrl_time_compress.effect_en: Allied normal pieces' skill cooldowns are cut by 25% — opening and later cooldowns both ×0.75

ctrl_binding_weight.name: 束缚重压
ctrl_binding_weight.effect: 当前目标移动 -25%、攻速 -20%、造成伤害 -20%，持续 2 秒，冷却 5 秒
ctrl_binding_weight.effect_en: Target movement -25%, attack speed -20%, and outgoing damage -20% for 2s, 5s cooldown
ctrl_binding_weight.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

atk_blood_pact.name: 血契之刃
atk_blood_pact.effect: 我方普通棋子 ATK x1.25，同时自身永久获得失血状态；胡牌手激活后为 ATK x1.50
atk_blood_pact.effect_en: Allied normal pieces gain ATK ×1.25 and bleed permanently themselves; ATK ×1.50 once Winning Hand is active

atk_fury_roster.name: 狂怒阵容
atk_fury_roster.effect: 普通棋子上限从 7 提高到 8
atk_fury_roster.effect_en: Raises the normal piece limit from 7 to 8
atk_fury_roster.trigger_en: Always active in the prep phase

atk_burst_core.name: 爆裂核心
atk_burst_core.effect_en: Allied normal pieces gain +25% crit chance

atk_wail_resonance.name: 哀鸣共鸣
atk_wail_resonance.effect: 击杀敌人时，对死亡目标周围 180 范围内敌人造成其最大生命 15% 真实伤害
atk_wail_resonance.effect_en: On a kill, enemies within 180 of the corpse take 15% of their own max HP as true damage
atk_wail_resonance.trigger: 我方普通棋子击杀敌人时
atk_wail_resonance.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece kills an enemy

atk_frenzy_assault.name: 狂暴进攻
atk_frenzy_assault.effect: 攻击同一目标时自身攻速 x1.15，可叠；换目标重置
atk_frenzy_assault.effect_en: Attacking the same target stacks attack speed ×1.15; resets on target switch

money_compound.name: 复利之道
money_compound.effect: 战后利息额外 +5% 当前金币；本回合未花金币则再额外 +3%
money_compound.effect_en: Post-battle interest gains 5% of current gold, plus another 3% if no gold was spent this round

money_generous_fate.name: 慷慨命运
money_generous_fate.effect: 准备阶段每回合可手动参与 1 次赌博：50% 概率金币变为 2.5 倍，50% 概率损失当前金币 80%；与诡诈命运联动后变为 60% 变为 2.5 倍、40% 损失当前金币 50%
money_generous_fate.effect_en: One manual gamble per prep round: 50% to raise your gold to 2.5x, 50% to lose 80% of it; with Trickster's Fate it becomes 60% to 2.5x / 40% lose half

money_discount.name: 折扣令牌
money_discount.effect: 棋子商店价格 -30%，最低 1 金
money_discount.trigger_en: When buying pieces in the prep phase

money_golden_altar.name: 黄金祭坛
money_golden_altar.effect: 准备阶段每次使用：法阵 HP -2、金币 +100，每回合最多 3 次，HP <=10 不可用；本回合不使用则战后法阵 HP +1
money_golden_altar.effect_en: Each prep use costs 2 formation HP and grants 100 gold, up to 3 uses per round; unavailable at HP <=10. If unused this round, restore 1 formation HP after battle

money_lucky_envelope.name: 幸运信封
money_lucky_envelope.effect_en: After battle, randomly gain 30, 40, or 50 gold

elem_flame_shatter.name: 炎焰碎裂
elem_flame_shatter.effect: 攻击有 25% 概率额外造成 ATK 40% 真实伤害
elem_flame_shatter.effect_en: Attacks have a 25% chance to deal an extra 40% ATK as true damage
elem_flame_shatter.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

elem_frost_blade.name: 冰封霜刃
elem_frost_blade.effect: 攻击有 25% 概率使目标移动 -35%、攻速 -50%，持续 2 秒
elem_frost_blade.effect_en: Attacks have a 25% chance to reduce target movement by 35% and attack speed by 50% for 2s
elem_frost_blade.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

elem_thunder_haste.name: 雷霆加速
elem_thunder_haste.effect: 攻击有 25% 概率使自身攻速 +60%，持续 3 秒；重复触发只刷新时间，不叠加
elem_thunder_haste.effect_en: Attacks have a 25% chance to grant +60% attack speed for 3s; retriggering refreshes the duration instead of stacking
elem_thunder_haste.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

elem_toxic_spread.name: 剧毒蔓延
elem_toxic_spread.effect: 攻击有 25% 概率使目标中毒
elem_toxic_spread.effect_en: Attacks have a 25% chance to poison the target
elem_toxic_spread.trigger_en: When an allied normal piece attacks

link_phoenix.name: 凤凰涅槃
link_phoenix.requires_text: 哀鸣共鸣 + 亡魂反击
link_phoenix.effect: 我方普通棋子死亡后以 40% 最大生命复活，获得 3 秒无敌，之后强制死亡
link_phoenix.effect_en: Allied normal pieces revive at 40% max HP with 3s invulnerability, then die for good

link_money_magic.name: 金钱魔法
link_money_magic.requires_text: 幸运信封 + 时空压缩
link_money_magic.effect_en: After battle, randomly gain another 60, 70, or 80 gold, with a 10% chance for 200 more

link_blood_covenant.name: 血之契约
link_blood_covenant.requires_text: 炎焰碎裂 + 吸血纹章
link_blood_covenant.effect: 炎焰碎裂触发时，真实伤害从 ATK 40% 提高到 ATK 100%
link_blood_covenant.effect_en: Flame Shatter's true damage rises from 40% ATK to 100% ATK

link_paralysis_shackles.name: 瘫痪枷锁
link_paralysis_shackles.requires_text: 打断锁链 + 冰封霜刃
link_paralysis_shackles.effect: 打断锁链成功缴械后触发冰属性效果，使目标受伤 +25%、治疗效果 -75%，持续 4 秒
link_paralysis_shackles.effect_en: A successful Interrupt Chain also applies ice; target takes 25% more damage and receives 75% less healing for 4s

link_oppression_counter.name: 压迫反击
link_oppression_counter.requires_text: 束缚重压 + 狂暴进攻
link_oppression_counter.effect: 我方普通棋子被攻击时，对攻击者施加减攻 25%，持续 2 秒；狂暴进攻仍对攻击者叠加
link_oppression_counter.effect_en: When a friendly normal piece is hit, the attacker gets ATK -25% for 2s; Frenzy Assault still stacks on the attacker

link_fraud_fate.name: 诡诈命运
link_fraud_fate.requires_text: 幻影步伐 + 慷慨命运
link_fraud_fate.effect: 慷慨命运变为准备阶段每回合手动赌博 1 次：60% 金币变为 2.5 倍，40% 损失当前金币 50%
link_fraud_fate.effect_en: Generous Fate becomes one manual gamble per prep round: 60% to raise your gold to 2.5x, 40% to lose half of it

link_iron_maiden.name: 铁处女
link_iron_maiden.requires_text: 铁壁之护 + 腐蚀毒针
link_iron_maiden.effect: 我方普通棋子受击时，使攻击者失血 5 秒且 DEF -50% 持续 5 秒，冷却 8 秒
link_iron_maiden.effect_en: When a friendly normal piece is hit, bleed the attacker for 5s and reduce DEF by 50% for 5s, 8s cooldown

link_toxic_burst.name: 剧毒爆发
link_toxic_burst.requires_text: 爆裂核心 + 剧毒蔓延
link_toxic_burst.effect: 普通棋子造成伤害时，中毒目标有 50% 概率立即结算剩余毒伤并清除中毒
link_toxic_burst.effect_en: When a normal piece deals damage, a poisoned target has a 50% chance to take all remaining poison damage at once and lose the poison

link_rich_path.name: 富裕之路
link_rich_path.requires_text: 复利之道 + 雷霆加速
link_rich_path.effect: 我方普通棋子造成伤害后 25% 概率 +10 金
link_rich_path.effect_en: After a friendly normal piece deals damage, 25% chance to gain 10 gold

link_clearance_sale.name: 清仓特卖
link_clearance_sale.requires_text: 狂怒阵容 + 折扣令牌
link_clearance_sale.effect: 自动激活，同队所有人的棋子商店价格 -60%，最低 1 金
link_clearance_sale.effect_en: Activates automatically: all teammates get 60% off piece shop prices, minimum 1 gold

link_hu_pai_master.name: 胡牌手
link_hu_pai_master.requires_text: 生命丰碑 + 黄金祭坛 + 震荡余波 + 血契之刃 + 狂怒阵容
link_hu_pai_master.requires_text_en: Life Monument + Golden Altar + Shockwave + Blood Pact + Fury Roster
link_hu_pai_master.effect: 集齐生命丰碑、黄金祭坛、震荡余波、血契之刃、狂怒阵容时立即回复法阵 HP +2；生命丰碑 +40%、震荡余波眩晕 2 秒、血契之刃 ATK x1.50、狂怒阵容上限 9；黄金祭坛使用时不扣 HP，仍得 +100 金，每回合最多 3 次，HP <=10 不可用
link_hu_pai_master.effect_en: On completing Life Monument, Golden Altar, Shockwave, Blood Pact, and Fury Roster, immediately restore 2 formation HP. Life Monument +40%, Shockwave stun 2s, Blood Pact ATK x1.50, roster cap 9; Golden Altar costs no HP and still grants 100 gold per use, up to 3 times per round, unavailable at HP <=10

set_defense.name: 4防御
set_defense.effect: 普通棋子开战 HP/DEF +30%，闪避 +15%。
set_defense.effect_en: Normal units gain HP/DEF +30% and Dodge +15% at battle start.

set_control.name: 4控制
set_control.effect: 普通棋子用普攻打出最后一击击杀敌人时，该棋子技能冷却立刻刷新（技能击杀不算）。
set_control.effect_en: When a normal unit lands the killing blow with a basic attack, its skill cooldown resets immediately (skill kills don't count).

set_attack.name: 4攻击
set_attack.effect: 普通棋子普攻后对生命 <=10% 的非 Boss 目标直接斩杀，触发斩杀的棋子攻速 +25% 持续 5 秒，重复触发只刷新时间；无敌也挡不住斩杀
set_attack.effect_en: After a normal unit's basic attack, execute non-Boss targets at <=10% HP even through invulnerability; the executing unit gains 25% attack speed for 5s, refreshing duration on repeat

set_money.name: 4金钱
set_money.effect: 开战时，每持有 1000 金，普通棋子攻击与生命 +10%，最高 +100%。
set_money.effect_en: At battle start, normal pieces gain +10% ATK and HP per 1,000 gold owned, up to +100%.

set_element.name: 4元素
set_element.effect: 普通棋子攻击 20% 概率触发 180 范围元素爆发，造成目标最大生命 10% 真实伤害；每个棋子内置冷却 2 秒
set_element.effect_en: Each normal unit's attack has a 20% chance to trigger an elemental burst in radius 180 for 10% max HP true damage, with its own 2s cooldown
